Welcome to Manav Janhit Kalyan. These Terms & Conditions explain the rules and guidelines for using our website and engaging with our services. By accessing our website, you agree to be bound by these terms.

02

Contributions made through our website are voluntary and are used to support our charitable activities and initiatives. We strive to ensure a secure and transparent donation process.

Secure and Safe Payments

All donations are processed through trusted and secure payment systems with industry-standard encryption to protect your information.
